remarks: Welcome to Unit #19 at 100 Wolfpit Avenue-a beautifully maintained and move-in-ready home in the heart of Norwalk. This spacious 2-bedroom, 1 bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style.  Step inside to find an open-concept living and dining area featuring warm hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and a seamless flow-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The private balcony off the dining room offers a peaceful retreat for morning coffee or evening relaxation.  One truly unique feature it the separate lower level. Ideal for an art studio, private office, or just additional storage.   Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, central air, assigned parking, and extra storage. The well-maintained complex is pet-friendly and ideally located near I-95, the Merritt Parkway, shopping, dining, public transportation, and Norwalk's vibrant downtown.  Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, downsizing, or looking for an investment opportunity, this unit checks all the boxes. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of Norwalk!
